niche_preference_profile: Prefers polished, structured interfaces that feel complete, orderly, and easy to scan. They consistently like clear hierarchy, coherent sectioning, populated content, and layouts with strong flow rather than fragmented modules. Visually, they often favor restrained, calm styling with subtle surfaces, muted accents, and low-noise presentation, though they are inconsistent on light versus dark theme and on how expressive or dramatic the visual tone should be.

criteria.description: Prefers screens that feel fully populated, resolved, and complete, with coherent sections and no empty or unfinished-looking containers or rows.
Prefers strong, legible hierarchy with an obvious title, well-separated sections, and a clear top-to-bottom reading order.
Prefers visually disciplined interfaces with fewer decorative effects, less promotional styling, and reduced clutter from extra controls, blur, glow, or competing modules.
Prefers continuous layouts and systematic grouping that read as one coherent flow, rather than fragmented cards, carousels, detached modules, or mixed interaction patterns.
Prefers evenly distributed content and balanced spatial rhythm, avoiding top-heavy layouts, dead space, or awkwardly fragmented lower areas.
Prefers subtle, polished surface styling such as gentle contrast, lighter dividers, softer cards, and calmer visual treatment over chunkier or harsher blocks.
